# Kansai Karate Willawong

> Traditional Shitoryu Shukokai karate for families in Willawong, QLD, Australia.

Kansai Karate Willawong is a licensed dojo under Kansai Karate Academy, led by Sensei Allan Reyes (Sandan — 3rd Dan). Programs available for all ages from 3 years upward.

## Programs
- Cubs (Ages 3–4)
- Little Lions (Ages 5–7)
- Juniors (Ages 8–12)
- Adults & Teens (Ages 13+)

## Contact
- Address: Unit 3, 14 Buttonwood Place, Willawong QLD 4110
- Phone: 0421 366 355
- Email: info@kansaikaratewillawong.com.au
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/kansaikaratewillawong

## Style
Shitoryu Shukokai — traditional Japanese karate

## Affiliations
Queensland Karate Association (QKA), Australian Karate Federation (AKF)
